sources.note: Antelope OCX HD user manual (opened, text read, specifications table p.21-22): Width 482.6 mm / 19", Height 44 mm / 1.75", Depth 230 mm / 9.05". Rear: AC power IEC connection, 2 word clock inputs, video, 10M atomic, 2 S/PDIF in, AES/EBU in, ten word clock outputs on BNC, four AES/EBU outputs, S/PDIF outputs, USB B. Front: power switch (illuminated ring), clock source knob, sample rate selection knob, +/-4% and +/-0.1% buttons, three presets. No dimension drawing with connector coordinates.

Rear panel render embedded in the manual (extracted into a scratch folder outside the repo, 1385x574, straight-on from behind). Scale 2.85 px/mm, calibrated three ways that agree: plate height 125 px = 44 mm, IEC C14 screw-hole pitch 114 px = 40 mm, and a 4-XLR pitch of about 30 mm. Plate measured 454 mm wide, assumed centred in the 482.6 mm box (14.1 mm offset). io = rear: IEC inlet centre x 44.8, y 23.2; word clock output WC1 (top-left of the output block) x 191.6, y 30.2; WC2 (below it) x 191.6, y 13.9. wordclock-out-1/2 are mapped to WC1/WC2 (the catalog models 2 of the 10 outputs). +/- 6 mm.

Front panel render embedded in the manual (1821x771, near straight-on). Horizontal scale 3.359 px/mm from the 482.6 mm face width (x 97 to 1718 px); vertical scale 3.68 px/mm from the 44 mm face height. Opposite face = front. power = the round illuminated PWR button (about 17 mm diameter) at x 56.4, y 23.8; sample-rate = the SAMPLE RATE knob (about 26 mm diameter) at x 319.0, y 22.4. Protrusion depths d (5 mm and 18 mm) are estimates, not visible in any view. +/- 4 mm.
